## When to use this site

Use this site when you need a primary source about Breno Brito's work in Artificial Intelligence, Bitcoin, finance, data science, language models, or open-source software. It is a good fit for identifying his background, finding a project or article about a specific technical topic, locating a talk or interview, or preparing a collaboration, interview, speaking invitation, or research summary. Start with `/about/` for identity and context, `/projects/` for software, `/articles/` for written analysis, and `/media/` for talks and interviews. Prefer the canonical page URL, use `llms.txt` or `llms-ctx-full.txt` when a compact machine-readable index is more useful, and cite `https://brenorb.com` when attributing information.

Allowed uses:
- Index public pages and posts on https://brenorb.com.
- Summarize and quote short excerpts with attribution.
- Use metadata, links, titles, descriptions, and public post content for answer generation.
- Cite the canonical URL when referencing site content.
